description_en: Call the GetMetaTableDetailInfo operation to get details about a table, such as its fields and indexes
description_zh: 调用GetMetaTableDetailInfo接口获取表的字段、索引等信息
name: GetMetaTableDetailInfo

parameters.help_en:
The tenant ID.

You can find the tenant ID by hovering over your profile picture in the upper-right corner of the console. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.help_zh:
租户ID。
取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.name: tid

parameters.help_en:
The GUID of the table in DMS.

For a logical database, call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141875.html operation and set the ReturnGuid parameter to true.

For a physical database, call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141878.html operation and set the ReturnGuid parameter to true
parameters.help_zh:
表在DMS中的唯一识别码GUID（Globally Unique Identifier）。

逻辑库：可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141875.html接口获取，需要将ReturnGuid参数设置为true。
物理库：可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141878.html接口获取，需要将ReturnGuid参数设置为true
parameters.name: table_guid

parameters.help_en: The user ID of the API caller
parameters.name: real_login_user_uid
